changes: Public beta. Versions now count V0.2.0, V0.2.1 and onward up to V1.0.0, the store release. Updates are published at palcikevicius-glitch.github.io.
The ritual meter now fills from defeated spirits (guardians much more) and boss damage instead of time. It stays frozen while a ritual or its echo is active and restarts from zero afterwards.

Forgotten Village has its own bosses: the Scarecrow Warden, the Grave Hound and a rebuilt Bell Keeper. Lantern Quarry has the Lantern Thief and the Stone Breather. Each has its own sprite, movement, three phases and attacks.

New boss attacks include crow fans, exploding straw dolls, pounces, claw sweeps, summoned packs, bell rings with a safe gap, bell pillars, a shrinking bell cage, blinking, stolen light, lantern mines, burrowing, rolling boulders, rock lines and dust breath.
Boss arenas are larger: 400 units on every map, and the Drowned Mill arena is no longer cramped. Every attack shows its full danger area first and always leaves a way out.
A boss health bar with the boss name appears at the top of the screen.
Drowned Mill, Glass Marsh and Bellwood keep their current boss until their own bosses arrive in a later update. Your progress and unfinished journeys are kept.
